purpose: Official HPE Networking end-of-sale, replacement-product, and support-lifecycle notices across all networking product categories.
notes: Refresh with ingestion/scrape_security_lifecycle.py. The XML feed is the data source behind HPE's historical all-product End of Sale archive; the official hardware PDF adds SKU-level dates and replacements. HPE does not publish a current crawlable index for every individual modern notice, so answers must cite the notice date and avoid implying the archive is exhaustive beyond its published entries.
